name: comp-587
title: App Icon Nav Header
description: A dark header with a starburst logo, three rounded links that pair an icon with a word (Home, Inbox, Insights), and a search box with a magnifier at the right.
use: A web app needs a slim header combining a few icon links with search.
avoid: Only three fixed areas are wired; search has no results logic and the links are placeholders.
a11y: Nav links carry visible text, but the logo link is unnamed and the search field has no label. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A slim dark header with a starburst logo on the left, three pill links for Home, Inbox and Insights each with a small icon, and a rounded search field with a magnifier at the right. The current link sits inside a faint rounded outline.
behaves: Moving the pointer over a nav pill gives it a faint rounded outline, while Home keeps a persistent active outline. Typing in the search field fills it with a query and adds a native clear button.
customise: The three nav labels, their icons, the active item and the search placeholder are set in the file; no props change them.
weight: light: A logo, three small links and one input.
demo: Links read Home, Inbox and Insights; the search placeholder is Search... and the typed example is a short query.
issues: Catalogue claims an app switcher, notifications, user menu and upgrade button; none are here.
polishWhy: Clean, evenly spaced header; active and hover outlines look almost identical.
